receipts.first_text_witness: What if I told you that everything you've been taught about money is backwards? That the people who claim money doesn't matter are often the ones whose lives have been most damaged by not having it. While you're scrolling through social media seeing people post about their minimalist lifestyles and how they found happiness without material possessions, they're probably doing it from their expensive laptop in their parents' house. My name is Nick and I've spent years studying how money
receipts.last_text_witness: to judge your worth by your bank balance. But but pretending money doesn't matter while it controls every major decision in your life isn't enlightenment. It's selfdeception. Money is a tool. And like any tool, it's better to have it and not need it than to need it and not have it. Stop letting people who benefit from your financial dependence convince you that wanting security makes you shallow. Your future self will thank you for caring about money today.
